title: Siemens SENTRON PAC2200 Power Monitoring Device
description: Baseline model for the Siemens SENTRON PAC2200 power monitoring device (versions with an Ethernet Modbus TCP or an RS485 Modbus RTU interface, 5 A and 65 A devices), read over Modbus. Register map: SENTRON PAC2200 Equipment Manual 12/2022 L1V30415167B-06, Appendix A.1.3 'Modbus measured variables with the function codes 0x03 and 0x04', Table A-3, PDF pages 107-110. The manual lists each value by an 'offset' and does not state the address on the wire. The PAC2200 uses the same register map as the PAC3200: the Siemens document 'SIMATIC S7-1500 Block for Connecting Modbus TCP Devices to Energy Suite V15', Entry ID 109749074 V1.1, PDF page 9, supplies one pre-configured register map for the SENTRON PAC2200, PAC3200 (T) and PAC4200. For the PAC3200 the Siemens application example 'Data Exchange between S7-1200 and SENTRON PAC via MODBUS TCP (Set 22)', Entry ID 40614428, Table 3-12 on PDF page 26, reads the total active power (offset 65) with MB_DATA_ADDR 40001 + 65 = 40066, and the Siemens document 'Modbus/TCP with MB_CLIENT and MB_SERVER', Entry ID 102020340, Table 4-5, PDF pages 23-24, maps MB_DATA_ADDR 40001 to the holding register at remote address 0. So the offset is the zero-based address on the wire: offset 1 (the voltage UL1-N) is address 1, and address 0 is not used. Registers are read with function code 03 (04 returns the same data); a read must start on the first register of a value (manual, PDF page 107). Float values are IEEE 754 in two registers, unsigned long values in two registers and double values in four registers; the manuals do not state the word order, and the Set 22 example reads the two registers of the active power directly as an S7 Real, which means the first register holds the high word. The model reads the high word first for every multi-register value, and no device was read on hardware. Left out: the settings, the command parameters and device information, the counters of parameter changes, the configurable energy counter, the cumulated average power and load profile values, the period values and their time stamps, the secondary (MID) energy totals, and the float copies of the energy values at offset 2801 onward.
